The White-lipped Grove Snail
Background
•   This is an air-breathing land snail.
•   It has a distinctive shell pattern, with a large variation in colour.
•   Its main diet is dead or decaying .
•   To obtain necessary minerals, it also eats .
•   It is found exclusively in Ireland and the Pyrenees mountains, and nowhere in between.
University of Nottingham study
•   Via the internet, volunteers were recruited for the of snails.
•   Researchers analysed the snails' genetic materials.
Findings and theories
•   Distributions in both locations were the same variety.
•   The snail's arrival in Ireland was quite recent.
•   "Convergent evolution" is very unlikely.
•   Natural migration is ruled out as these snails do not like .
•   In the Pyrenees, large piles of shells have been found in .
•   This indicates the snails were used as .
•   There is archaeological evidence of between the two areas.
•   The conclusion is that snails were most likely carried in .
Future work
•   A wider of the snails is required for the study.
•   One other organism will be investigated: a particular type of .

analyses.content: 录音用“source of nutrition”替换了“diet”，并用“in the process of rotting”替换了“decaying”，直接说明它主要的食物是植物。
你可能光顾着听“dead”，忽略了后面说明食物核心的大方向词，要注意抓取营养来源（nutrition）后紧跟的具体事物。
Its principal source of nutrition is plants which are either already dead or in the process of rotting, a characteristic it shares with a number of other species of snail.
录音明确提到为了获取钙和其他矿物质（minerals），它们会经常吃（用“consumes”替换了“eats”）土壤。
听到获取矿物质的目的（To get these）时，你容易错过紧随其后的动作和宾语，切记答案通常跟在表明目的的句子之后。
A final point about its ecology is that it also needs calcium and other minerals to keep it healthy. To get these, it frequently consumes soil, which contains these minerals.
录音中直接提到招募志愿者（volunteers）来负责收集（collection）蜗牛标本，与题干完美契合。
你可能会在“collection”后多带上“specimens”这个词，但题目要求只填一个词，填核心动作名词即可。

Via the internet, they set up what is known as a mega lab, recruiting numerous volunteers across Europe to be responsible for the collection of snail specimens, which were then sent to the university lab.
录音指出自然迁徙（natural migration）被排除了（ruled out），因为它们讨厌（用“hate”替换了“do not like”）盐。
你可能会一听到“sea”就急着填，但题目问的是它们“不喜欢”什么，一定要听准表示反感情感的词（hate）后面的内容。

The 2nd theory proposed is called natural migration, which would necessitate the snails swimming the sea to Ireland. This was ruled out because they hate salt and simply wouldn't have embarked on the journey across the sea, or had they tried, wouldn't have survived.
录音用“mounds”替换了“large piles”，明确指出大量蜗牛壳被扔在了洞穴（caves）里。
句子比较长的时候你容易迷失，遇到长句要专心抓取表示地点的介词短语（in caves）。

The team then started looking at different kinds of evidence, reviewing findings from various locations in the Pyrenees which showed that mounds of white-lipped snail shells had been thrown away in caves.
录音中直接总结说，石器时代的人类长期把这些蜗牛当作食物（used ... as food）。
遇到从句结构变化时你可能会跟丢，听到“must have been used ... as”这种典型的被动确认句型时，答案就在最后。
Clearly, these had been inhabited by Stone Age communities. This led to the conclusion that the snails must have been used over a long period by these Stone Age humans as food.
录音提到在爱尔兰和比利牛斯山脉的考古证据中，发现了两地人类之间存在贸易（trade）。
你可能会在“people”或“areas”等干扰信息中错失关键名词，要紧跟“there had been”后面引出的核心事件。

The team then looked at other types of archaeological evidence from prehistoric times in Ireland and the Pyrenees, and they found evidence that very early on there had been trade between the people living in these widely separated areas.
研究团队的最终结论（concluded）是，蜗牛最可能（most likely）的移动方式是在船（boats）里。
你可能因为信息过于密集而把后面补充说明状态的“fresh”当成答案，应该紧盯“traveled ... was in”之后跟的交通工具。

For all these reasons, the research team have tentatively concluded that the most likely way in which the snails traveled from east to west was in boats, and that they were transported live to keep them fresh for consumption on the journey.
录音用“broader”替换了题干的“wider”，直接说明了研究还需要查看更广泛的样本（sample）。
你听到“further work”时可能会想填词，但题干有限定词“wider”，一定要找准修饰词“broader”背后的中心名词。
The research team acknowledge that their study is in the early stages and needs further work. They recognize, for example, that they need to look at a broader sample of the snails.
录音先引出还有另一种生物（organism），随后立刻补充说明这种生物是一种树（species of tree），“species”完美替换了“type”。
答案跨了句子且在句首出现，你可能会在听到“organism”后觉得句子结束就走神了，要注意新话题引入后的后续补充说明。

They have found that there is probably at least one other type of organism which shows the same distribution pattern, the clear split between the Pyrenees and Ireland. This is a species of tree which they want to look at in more detail.
